quick_learners.description: Humans earn [b]INT%[/b] extra evolution points, in addition to [b]+{ep_creation_bonus}[/b] starting evolution points.

overachievers.description: Humans never settle on one gift. They get [b]2 talents[/b] instead of one at level 1.

passionate.description: Masters of the craft they dedicate themselves to, humans have a higher skill maximum than other races.

nightvision.description: Able to see clearly as long as there's a dim source of light.

elegance.description: Lighter bodies without sacrificing muscle, granting a Weight Value modifier of [b]{weight_mod}[/b].

fae_descent.description: In the veins of the elves runs the blood of their fae ancestors, granting them [b]+5 MP per level[/b].

pretty.description: {plural} are usually pretty. This can open new social opportunities, allowing for more seduction interactions for example.

lions_heart.description: A real Dwarf knows no fear! Additionally, musical buffs are [b]*{music_buff_mult}[/b], especially praise towards them.

tanks.description: Armor is extremely effective on dwarves, granting an extra [b](10+Level)%[/b] equipment armor when worn.

heavy_drinkers.description: Only a giant or another dwarf could ever hope to outdrink a dwarf. Resistance Rolls to alcohol are rolled with advantage.

rage.description: Rage can be activated once per fight for a good roleplay reason, making the ogre gain [b]+1 Stamina[/b] and [b]2dX[/b] damage based on strength for medium and heavy non-magic attacks. Lasts [b]2 turns[/b] and activates the [b]Wereform[/b].

warborn.description: A [b]10%[/b] bonus is added to natural armor and all attack rolls when surrounded by [b]war chants[/b], [b]cheering allies[/b] or [b]a ransacked environment[/b].

climbers.description: {plural} are capable of climbing most vertical surfaces without difficulty, not needing any skill check.Base climbing speed multiplier becomes [b]*{climb_speed_mult_base}[/b].

elusive.description: [b]+{racial_dodge_armor}%[/b] Dodge Armor as long as they are not wearing any heavy armor. (DONT FORGET TO IMPLEMENT THIS LIMIT)

treasure_smellers.description: Gremlins find treasure where there shouldn't normally be. Starting money [b]*{start_gold_mult}[/b].

forest_folk.description: {plural} never get lost in forests, and get advantage to Athletics checks when climbing a tree. (once real game, detailed full map if in forest)

mithridatism.description: Used to eat toxic plants since childhood, goblins automatically succeed their RRs against poisons and harmful potions regardless of difficulty. If no RR is normally allowed, goblins get to roll once.[b]Totally immune to poison damage.[/b]

darkvision.description: Able to see in complete darkness.

rebuildable.description: Trolls heal [b](CONST/5)+Level*3 HP[/b] at the start of each turn. Severed limbs regrow after a [b]long rest[/b].[b]Immune to bleeding.[/b]

insulated.description: Lightning seems ineffective on these humanoids. Chain lightnings don't touch them, and electric damage is halved.

insured.description: Trolls get [b](CONST+ Character Level)%[/b] Natural Armor.

mana_tattoos.description: Each Jinn receives a tattoo during childhood, and continues to enrich it throughout their life. These tattoos channel mana in a special way that offers up to [b]14[/b] abilities. Start at {initial_tattoo_count}

aerial.description: Mana and air forces give Jinn a Weight Value modifier of [b]{weight_mod}[/b].

odorless.description: As long as they keep a decent hygiene, a Jinn's body cannot be detected by smell.

infravision.description: Can perceive heat, even through thin walls. Advantage to perception rolls against hot blooded creatures, tracking included.

nonflammable.description: Tieflings take halved fire damage. The other half is handled by [b]Firepunch[/b].

smoldering_eyes.description: The blazing gaze of tieflings grants them advantage on intimidation rolls.

firepunch.description:
When taking fire or fire-hybrid damage, half of that damage is stored by the Tiefling's body. This stored damage can then be added as extra raw damage on a successful physical or elemental attack, taking its type. Storing damage to the next turn causes [b](stored damage/5) rounded down[/b] physical damage, and causes the tiefling's body to look noticeably hotter. 
[b]Cannot store more than CONST*(1+Level/2) damage.[/b]

polymorph.description: Dopplers can spend one turn to transform into the shape of any humanoid. If they are currently capable of seeing that humanoid, they have a [b](25+Level*5)%[/b] chance to copy all of their physical assets and handicaps as well. From imagination or memory, a humanoid is only copied in appearance. In this latter case, a successful perception roll with disadvantage against a performance check will result in the disguise being discovered.

fae_blood.description: Fairies are even more magical in nature than their fae ancestors. [b]+5 MP per level[/b], and the elemental bending skill depends on [b]Intelligence[/b] instead of [b]Strength[/b].

flutterers.description: Their wings flutter silently, allowing them to hover freely and quickly. This flight has a base speed multiplier of [b]*{flight_speed_mult_base}[/b]. It also grants [b]{racial_dodge_armor}%[/b] Dodge Armor and advantage on stealth rolls as long as the fairy is only wearing light armor.

resilient.description: [b]+7 HP per level[/b], as there's more to hit in a giant.

hyperthermic.description: Frost damage is halved, and no skill debuffs are suffered because of it.

heavy_lifting.description: Great weapons are considered one handed, and anything else a toothpick. Carry capacity is doubled.

disproportionate.description: A giant's huge body grants them advantage on physical resistance and athletics rolls. On top of that, [b]all AOE attacks have their radius doubled (tripled starting at level 7)[/b] whatever may their nature be, and all(yes) attacks gain [b]1dX[/b] damage per stamina, [b]2dX[/b] starting at level 7, [b]X based on level[/b].

swallow.description: A geleton can swallow an enemy on a successful [b]hand to hand attack roll[/b], and for [b]2 stamina points[/b]. The victim will not be able to do anything except attempting to escape using an athletics roll against their hand to hand once per turn. [b]Suffocation rules apply[/b].

nuclear.description: Instead of having vital organs, Geleton only have a coconut sized Core which stops them from going completely liquid. It counts as a head mechanically, unless polynuclear.

mutative.description: Geleton can spend evolution points to develop new, powerful mutations. [b]See mutations page[/b]. [b]30 extra initial EPs exclusively for mutations.[/b]

chrysalid.description: Upon a rest, be it long or short, a Kaphrax can eat an extra meal in order to place themselves in a cocoon which will [b]double their regens[/b]. For two meals, the chrysalid allows for [b]limb regeneration[/b].

hexapoda.description: [b]+{stamina_bonus} Stamina[/b], thanks to that extra pair of limbs. [b]{bleeding_limb_threshold} limbs[/b] must be lost to take bleeding.

entomorph.description: Each Kaphrax, at birth, gets [b]{zoomorphic_traits} zoomorphic arthropod traits[/b], up to [b]{zoomorphic_traits_max}[/b] if they take a handicap (zoomorphic or talent list) for each.

tentacles.description: 2 to 6 tentacles grow from the illithid's face, acting as a bit less controllable extra limbs. (no mechanics change)

glyatic_potential.description: Some Illithids, like humans, can awaken psychic powers, usually at birth. Although they never innately possess Major Arcana, their nervous system can safely accept them.

cephalomorph.description: Illithids get, at birth, [b]3 zoomorphic cephalopod traits[/b]. They gain an additional one at levels [b]3, 6 and 9[/b].

amphibian.description: A Thassalian breathes in both air and water.

lumiscales.description: These scales, some being bioluminescent, grant their owner [b]CONST%[/b] natural armor. They can be used to communicate silently, and to lightly illuminate a dark space.

dexterous_aquatic_tail.description: This tail, aside from setting the swimming speed multiplier at [b]*{swim_speed_mult_base}[/b], can be used as another arm.

ichthyomorph.description: Each Thassalian gets, at birth, [b]{zoomorphic_traits} zoomorphic thalassan traits[/b], [b]{zoomorphic_traits_max}[/b] if they take a handicap (zoomorphic or talent list).

panoramic_view.description: Eyes that extend the peripheral vision to one's back. Advantage on perception checks against stealth or when looking for someone. However, these wide-set eyes do kinda look stupid.

heavy_cavalry.description: A Kemoggon has a [b]*{speed_mult_choice} multiplier[/b] on either walking or swimming speed. Inventory capacity [b]*{carry_capacity_mult}[/b].

impulsive.description: Kemoggons are the first to react. [b]5+Level[/b] initiative bonus.

ungulomorph.description: Each Kemoggon gets, at birth, [b]{zoomorphic_traits} zoomorphic ungulate traits[/b], [b]{zoomorphic_traits_max}[/b] if they take a handicap (zoomorphic or talents list).

gliromorph.description: Each Iyawana gets, at birth, [b]{zoomorphic_traits} zoomorphic murine traits[/b], [b]{zoomorphic_traits_max}[/b] if they take a handicap (zoomorphic or talents list).

claws.description: Sharp claws that deal extra hand to hand damage proportional to strength: [b]Str/4[/b] for Light Attacks, [b]Str/2[/b] for Medium Attacks, [b]Str*3/4[/b] for Heavy Attacks.

bloodthirsty.description: When an enemy is at or below mid-life, Kenshars can enter an entranced state, gaining either [b]advantage on all attacks[/b] against them, or [b]an extra free movement[/b] to chase them. This choice can be changed at the beginning of each turn. If they choose to be entranced, they cannot attack another target until the current one is downed.

carniothrope.description: Each Kenshar gets, at birth, [b]{zoomorphic_traits} zoomorphic carnivoran traits[/b], [b]{zoomorphic_traits_max}[/b] if they take a handicap (zoomorphic or talents list).

harpies.description: Asvyn are capable of imitating the voices and accents of other humanoids thanks to their unique vocal cords. These also make them excellent singers.

survivors.description: Asvyn, whatever their morphology, only take the effects caused by terrain, climate and temperature at [b]*{environment_effect_mult}[/b], and only need [b]one meal per day[/b].

dexterous_legs.description: These humanoids are capable of using their legs like arms, albeit with a [b]{leg_action_penalty}% penalty[/b] on any action.

aviothrope.description: Each Asvyn gets, at birth, [b]{zoomorphic_traits} zoomorphic avian traits[/b], [b]{zoomorphic_traits_max}[/b] if they take a handicap (zoomorphic or talents list).

ectothymic.description: The emotions of Ganwatl, if existing, work differently. [b]Total immunity to induced feelings[/b], be they by magic or potion.

ectotherm.description: Ganwatl metabolism is slowed. They only need [b]one meal per day[/b], and can hold their breath up to [b]{breath_hold_mins} minutes[/b] (short scene).

sauromorph.description: Each Ganwatl, at birth, gets [b]{zoomorphic_traits} zoomorphic squamatan traits[/b], up to [b]{zoomorphic_traits_max}[/b] if they take a handicap (zoomorphic or talent list) for each extra trait.
